label: Market Close
headline: S&P 500 -0.5%, Nasdaq 100 -2.0%, Dow above 50,000, chip ETF -7.3%, Ambarella -37% after hours
stance: Chip stocks gave back part of Monday's rally while the Dow rose. Treasuries barely moved ahead of Wednesday's PCE.

scorecard.call: Morning: Nvidia -4% pre-market after its CEO was reinstated.
Morning: US stock futures lower (~4:23am ET).
scorecard.actual: Held for tech only. Nasdaq 100 closed -2.0%; the Dow closed +0.9%.

scorecard.call: Morning: Treasuries did not move on Monday's rally.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Consumer confidence 103.3 in November vs 92.5 expected (~10:00am ET).
$70bn 5y auction stopped at 4.719% vs 4.716% when-issued (~1:06pm ET). Bid-to-cover 2.37x vs 2.31x average.
WTI settled $82.05, +2.35% (~2:53pm ET). Gold futures -2.5% to $3,559 (~6:32pm ET).

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Semiconductor ETF -7.3% at the close after Monday's +15.0%.
Consumer staples ETF +1.7% and Russell 2000 +0.6% at the close.
European stocks fell on new US tariff plans: Italy -1.8%, DAX -1.3% (~12:06pm ET).

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HYG -0.12%, LQD -0.13% at the close. Credit ETFs fell far less than tech stocks.

items.head: Ambarella -37% after hours (~6:42pm ET)
items.body: Missed Q3 estimates and guided Q4 far below forecasts (~5:00pm ET). Stock had closed -20.0%.

items.head: Urban Outfitters -12% after hours (~6:35pm ET)
items.body: Shares fell after Q3 results (~4:56pm ET).

items.head: Workday -7.6% after hours (~6:40pm ET)
items.body: Beat on revenue and earnings per share (~4:18pm ET). Revenue $2.705bn, +11.2% from a year ago.

items.head: Dell +1.5% after hours (~6:42pm ET)
items.body: Sales more than doubled on AI servers; $25bn buyback (~5:07pm ET). Stock had closed -11.8%.
